t: You tap your card for a coffee. Five dollars.
action: hero at the cafe counter taps his card on the terminal

t: Beep. And the number above your head drops by five.
action: hero freezes, looks up at the badge

t: Not five dollars. Five minutes. Of your life.
action: close-up, hero touches his face, worried

t: What if every dollar you spent cost you one minute of your life?
action: hero looks at a coin that turns into a clock
graphic: title words fly in one by one; $1 coin flips into a clock

t: Sounds cheap, right? A dollar a minute.
action: hero walks down the evening street, shrugs, smirks

t: Then rent day comes. Fifteen hundred dollars.
action: hero at the kitchen table, taps PAY on the phone
graphic: calendar RENT DAY, phone: Pay rent $1,500

t: That's twenty-five hours. Gone in one tap.
And one day, you'll get a bill that isn't even yours.
action: an envelope slides under the door, hero picks it up
